_comment: Branch protection policy for main. Applied via scripts/apply-branch-protection.sh. See docs/dev/branch-protection.md for rationale. CODEOWNERS was removed (2-person team where both maintainers own everything, so code-owner review added friction without value). Review is no longer code-owner-scoped and no approvals are required; the reporting PR checks below are the gate. The full workspace, format-fence, and RustFS suites run post-merge; a red main branch is stop-the-line until fixed or reverted.
